title: Dictionary Values
answer:
Here's a Python program that prints all the values in a given dictionary:

```python
# Given dictionary
dictionary = {'name': 'Charlie', 'age': 30, 'city': 'Sydney'}

# Print all values
for value in dictionary.values():
    print(value)
```

When you run this program with the sample input {'name': 'Charlie', 'age': 30, 'city': 'Sydney'}, it will output:

```
Charlie
30
Sydney
```
